description: This file defines type aliases and exports related to setup helpers for provider plugins in a machine learning or AI application. It primarily re-exports types and functions from other modules to facilitate plugin setup and configuration.

methods.name: applyProviderDefaultModel
methods.description: Sets or applies default models for providers, as imported from the provider setup module.

methods.name: configureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderNonInteractive
methods.description: Configures a self-hosted provider that is compatible with OpenAI, in non-interactive mode.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleLocalModels
methods.description: Discovers local models compatible with OpenAI.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Discovers self-hosted providers compatible with OpenAI.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Prompts user and configures a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible provider.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderAuth
methods.description: Prompts user and configures authentication for a self-hosted provider.
